assessment: Surveillance screening can help us estimate the prevalence of SARS-CoV-2 infection and co-infection with other respiratory pathogens. This work offers a high-throughput and cost-effective method to do such surveillance based on RT-LAMP combined with deep sequencing. This method can be applied to clinical samples for an accurate reading of the fraction of infections where the SARS-CoV-2 titer is moderate or high.
